name: epic-loop
description: Shape large engineering efforts into durable epic workspaces, then run implementation across sessions through Codex or Claude Code hooks without losing intent, decisions, or task context.

interface.shortDescription: Keep long-running engineering epics coherent across agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Working with coding agents creates a second body of work alongside the code: intent, specs, decisions, risks, and task breakdowns. Epic Loop gives that work a durable home inside the target repository. Shape an epic into docs, phases, and tasks, then run implementation through Codex or Claude Code hooks in a techlead/engineer loop that keeps state on disk and can resume across sessions.
defaultPrompt:
$epic-loop start a new epic for the following area of functionality:
[describe the problem area or functionality you need to solve]
